answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 27599 Country: United States of America Title: I went from USA to Jeddah on April 2010. I stayed with my relatives in Jeddah for 3-4 days, then I made intention of Umrah, put ihram in Jeddah, and went to Makkah to complete my umrah? Was this right? Question: Assalamu alykum, I went from USA to Jeddah on April 2010. I stayed with my relatives in Jeddah for 3-4 days, then I made intention of Umrah, put ihram in Jeddah, and went to Makkah to complete my umrah? Was this right? Answer ID: 27599 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1823/515/TL=1431) Yes, you were alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
